FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
WHERE p.sku = (
    SELECT sku
    FROM sales_daily
    GROUP BY sku
    ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC, sku
    LIMIT 1
)
